environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in namespace 'data-services'. Pod runs as UID 1000 with default securityContext. The /tmp directory is backed by the node's filesystem (emptyDir with no medium specified). Multiple pods from different services in the same namespace share node-level /tmp via hostPath volume mount inherited from a legacy DaemonSet configuration. No Istio sidecar injected. Service is exposed via NodePort and accessible from any pod in the cluster.
